nature.note: What the forest edge gives (TODO N1-N5, design document 5.9). Each pool is a number from 0 to `max` that falls when something is gathered (`recipes`: how much one tap takes) and grows back by `regrow` every question. The yield of a tap is its amount x max(floor, pool / max), rounded, at least 1, so the campfire is never impossible. The trees are a cycle instead: a tree that is felled becomes a stump, a stump a sapling after about `stumpToSapling` questions, a sapling a tree after about `saplingToTree`. The first time a pool falls below `adviceBelow` of its maximum there is a short advice (a recommendation first, then the yield falls), and again after `adviceEvery` questions. The numbers are shown in the forest edge's window once the card *Take only what grows back* is learned (frozen until then, D4).

sticks.name: Sticks
sticks.advice: The forest edge is running low on sticks. Let it grow back for a while: they come back slowly.

stones.name: Loose stones
stones.advice: The loose stones at the forest edge are nearly gone. They hardly come back. Pick the stones out of your fields instead.

clay.name: Clay
clay.advice: The clay pit is getting empty. It fills up slowly: give it some time.

trees.name: Trees
trees.advice: Only a few trees are left at the forest edge. Stumps grow new saplings, and saplings grow into trees. Give them time.
